reviews.text: Great experience with this builder from startup to finish.  Great communication at first with Mark, he went above and beyond, even went to the office on a holiday weekend and a Saturday to accommodate our schedule.  Then the building communication with Fred was also spot on! They had a pool built in my backyard in 5 weeks, yes 5 weeks only! and that's because I pushed the 2 final stages out due to the holidays.  I would definitely recommend Mark and Fred and this company to build your pool!
reviews.author: Ignacio Parra

reviews.text:
If I had to sum it up in one word…. Quality!
Aquatic Arts did a great job on our pool & concrete. Very professional, amazing attention to detail, timely, flexible, provided nothing but quality, knowledgeable teams throughout the whole process!  Great Superintendent- Thank you Mark!  They listened to us and did exactly what we wanted. We highly recommend them! Thank you to the whole team!  We love it and are making wonderful family memories!
reviews.author: Tammy Lewis

reviews.text: Worst customer service ever! I have been trying to get cracked pavers replaced since they were installed. When they finally sent someone out to replace them, 1.5 yrs later, they used the wrong pavers that did not match. Still trying to get them replaced with the correct ones. We have called multiple times, texted, and showed up in person only to get the runaround.
reviews.author: stephen may

reviews.text: From start to finish, Aqutic Arts Pool N Spa has been fantastic! Parker helped designed our pool and the finished product was exactly how we envisioned. The project manager kept my wife and I up to date every step of the way and stayed on schedule. The team is very honest and professional. If you are thinking about building a pool, definitely stop by these guys. You won’t disappoint.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.text: I am very happy with the pool that AquaticArts designed and built for me. Starting off with Evan doing an amazing job bringing to life a pool that I had only envisioned. Then the entire build process with Fred was great. There were a few hiccups along the way, as to be expected, however all my concerns and questions were quickly resolved. Overall the process has been great from start to finish. I'm very happy with the price and quality of the pool.
reviews.author: Ryan Graf

reviews.text:
We recently built a pool with Aquatic Arts and we could not be more pleased! We worked with Parker on our pool design. We wanted something that fit well in our backyard, while also staying within our budget.

When the construction started Mark was our construction manager. He was incredible! Always one step ahead, visiting frequently, very knowledgeable and just overall great to work with! My husband and I would recommend Aquatic Arts and Mark specifically if you are looking at building a pool!
reviews.author: Kristen Paxton

reviews.text: My family decided to take our backyard to the next level. We shopped around and ultimately choose Aquatic Arts. They did a great job all around. Communication and commitment to quality has been top notch. We highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rick Garcia

reviews.text: We had our pool and covered structure built over the summer and into the fall. We had a great experience from start to finish. Parker took our vision and made it a reality. Fred was there every step of the way and can't thank him enough for answering our constant questions and concerns that came up during construction. From the date of excavation to the day we started filling our pool we were just shy of 13 weeks. Overall, we're extremely happy with how things all turned out and would do it all over again.
reviews.author: Stacy Salazar

reviews.text:
Best pool company in DFW that does fantastic work!  I would recommend them to anybody.

Hard to believe other people giving them a 1 star rating think that is is OK to ask them to fix stuff after three years???  Kinda pathetic!

Nothing but professional industry standard quality w this company.
reviews.author: Brian Johnson

reviews.text: Aquatic Arts designed and built our backyard oasis! From the design consultation through final inspection, their team made the process seamless and streamlined. Their sales and project management teams were fantastic to work with, offering timely response and creative solutions to a complicated and complex build. Their contractors did excellent work and were friendly and responsive to questions and suggestions along the way. Overall, we would highly recommend Aquatic Arts to anyone in the DFW area looking for high quality service and construction and excellent responsiveness throughout the process.
reviews.author: John Archer

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Aquatic Arts. Heidi designed our pool, and was patient with us while we picked our finishes in their office.  Mark our Project Manager jumped right in after we signed the contract, and had us going. Sub contractors, supplies, inspections were all scheduled as soon as they could be.  We only had a few weather days (freezing weather, rain) but everyone was back to doing what they do soon after.  Mark ran by most days to check on progress, and was always available to answer questions.  It was a great experience and we are enjoying the pool.  Thanks Mark, and the Aquatic Arts crew.
reviews.author: R Pessarra

reviews.text: We are very happy with our new pool.  The sales and design process with Parker was comfortable and easy.  Our project manager, Fred, was very communicative and available throughout the entire process.  Highly recommend Aquatic Arts Pool N Spa!
reviews.author: Michelle Cowling

reviews.text: Aquatic Arts did a wonderful job on a new installation. They were on time and very helpful whenever I reached out to them. The only complaint I have is that some of the design choices I made before the construction started were not in the final plans, and I did not notice until well into construction. The team was very receptive to making the changes, but I decided to not extend the construction time to correct the errors. The construction team was awesome and very accommodating and I cannot fault them for following the design. In projects like these, make sure to really examine the plans before signing off. I was too excited and did not do my due diligence. The pool and spa look beautiful and the project was completed on time.
reviews.author: Brian Sousa

reviews.text:
Aquatic Arts was very pleasant to work with from start to finish!! Micah our PM always kept us updated on what was going to happen next.  He was always there to answer any questions we had.
We love our design and can’t wait for warm weather so we jump in!!

Thank you Aquatics Arts for a beautiful pool!!
reviews.author: Stephanie Hendricks

reviews.text: We had such a good experience with Aquatic Arts. We had a pool, spa, and grill installed. Fred and his team managed to finish the project almost 2 months ahead of schedule, while ensuring quality did not take a hit. We love our new backyard and would highly recommend this company!
reviews.author: TreyDubois

reviews.text: Great Experience!  We contact Aquatic Arts and sat down to go over all the details of our outside dream.  In a couple if days they sent over a drawing and pictures, making adjustments as we requested.  A YEAR later we pulled the trigger and started the project.  It is a big job to get a pool done and with COVID, we were praying that they would continue the process and they did to completion.  All the subcontractors were wonderful but Fred,  our superintendent, on the project was exceptional.  He went above and beyond.  We had some minor changes along the way, like removing a step or making it longer and he helped make sure that everything was changed as we requested. They finished the fireplace with a design but my wife had a small change and the contractors came back to change it.  Aquatic Arts and their contractors and Fred did an exceptional job and we love our back yard oasis.  We never used to step in our back yard and now there is not a day that we're not back there enjoying it.  Thank you AAPNS for helping us make our oasis come to fruition.
reviews.author: Jene Morgan Cody Morgan

reviews.text: Aquatic Arts is the BEST! We couldn’t be happier with our pool! From start to finish, the team was professional, knowledgeable, and truly cared about bringing our vision to life. The craftsmanship and attention to detail are outstanding, and the entire process was smooth and stress-free. They kept us informed every step of the way and completed the project on time. Our backyard has been completely transformed into a dream oasis! If you’re looking for a top-notch pool builder, this is the team to call. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Taylor Barre

reviews.text: We contacted Aquatic Arts and Spa after receiving outrages quotes from other Dallas based companies. Aquatic Arts designed an absolutely beautiful pool for a fair price so we decided to move forward. Having never designed or built a pool before, we had no idea what to expect. Our project manager, Dawson, made the entire process so incredibly easy! He showed up on the very first day and every day in between from start to finish. My husband and I are picky to say the least and Dawson could not have been more patient, thorough, and understanding of our many questions. We were absolutely amazed at how quickly the whole project moved (and in the midst of a pandemic no less!). We had people here working every single day, even through the weekends, to ensure our pool was finished in 6 weeks. The finished product is absolutely beautiful and we could not be more happy.

reviews.text:
We love our pool & spa that was built by Aquatic Arts Pool N Spa! After researching several pool companies in the area, we scheduled a consultation with Aquatic Arts Pool N Spa based on their reviews and their pool designs, which were similar to what we were looking for. Thomas, the Designer who met with us initially, was on time, professional, and listened to our design goals. Thomas was able to educate and offer guidance as needed. When he presented his design to us shortly after our initial meeting, it was even better than we could have imagined! He was able to interpret our vision and, best of all, stayed within our budget.

Once it was time for construction, we met with Dawson who managed our project flawlessly from beginning to end. Throughout the process, he was available to answer our questions and quickly resolve any concerns. We were impressed by his ability to simultaneously monitor the current construction, plan ahead for future scheduling, and keep us informed along the way. He worked diligently and was our advocate in keeping the project on schedule. His experience was also evident when he was even able to help us with design decisions as they came up. A pool install is a big investment and can be somewhat overwhelming, but through transparency, open communication, flexibility, and attention to detail Dawson made the massive project stress-free and a success! We were also impressed with how hard working and respectful the various contractors were at our property. Based on our positive experience, we highly recommend Aquatic Arts Pool N Spa to anyone wanting to add a pool/spa in DFW!

reviews.text:
The guys at AAPNS built me the pool and spa of my dreams!

I started the process in early April with Thomas designing the build.  He was a straight shooter, told it like it was, no nonsense sales tactics.  He listened well about what I wanted and I couldn't be happier with the design.

Moved on to permitting, which was a big hassle given COVID delays with the city of Dallas, but GM Matthew was very patient with my weekly check-ins, coordinating financing, etc.  The city took 3.5 months to approve the permit (at no fault of AAPNS), and then they got started on the build right away.

Fred and Dawson oversaw the build, and communication was great throughout the process - very responsive.  Set clear expectations and was always willing to answer my questions and manage the build making sure everything was done perfect.  The build itself took 9.5 weeks from dig to filling the pool, and I couldn't be happier with the quality of the materials used and the final product.

Eric ran my "pool school" session and was really helpful in making sure I understood exactly how everything functions. Last, AAPNS used Year Round Pool for pool startup and the initial 3 weeks of cleaning service, and they're been great to work with so far.

Overall, I HIGHLY recommend the team at AAPNS - I interviewed a handful of builders to make this decision, and AAPNS offered a great value and ending up proving the quality of their work!

From start to finish, the team, led by the outstanding project manager, Fred, delivered an exceptional service that exceeded my expectations.
First and foremost, the speed at which they completed the project is remarkable. In just 13 weeks, I went from an empty backyard to a stunning, fully functional pool oasis. The efficiency and precision with which Aquatic Arts Pool Company operates are truly commendable.
One of the standout aspects of my experience was the clear and consistent communication provided by Fred. Throughout the process, he ensured I was well-informed about the project's timeline, the tasks are undertaken, and when the team would be on-site. This transparency and professionalism made the construction process smooth and stress-free.
Fred's proactive approach to project management was particularly impressive. Any concerns or issues that arose were immediately addressed and resolved with efficiency. Aquatic Arts values customer satisfaction, as they go above and beyond to ensure their clients a seamless and enjoyable experience.

data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The company appears to deliver good quality pools during construction with strong project management, as evidenced by detailed 5-star reviews. However, a clear and consistent pattern emerges from negative reviews on both Google and the lower Yelp rating: post-construction customer service, warranty honor, and repair follow-through are major weaknesses. The 1-year warranty period is a specific point of contention. The significant rating discrepancy is explained by this service cliff after project completion.
fake_signals: One 5-star review (Brian Johnson) directly attacks other negative reviewers, which is unusual for a genuine customer review and suggests possible owner/employee involvement.

negative_evidence: Multiple complaints about refusal to fix issues after the 1-year warranty (Sun Shine, Sergio Jimenez, Erin A)
Complaint about using wrong materials for a warranty repair (stephen may)
Complaint about slow response (60+ days) causing warranty to expire (Sergio Jimenez)
positive_evidence: Positive reviews mention good communication and problem resolution during construction.

authentic_signals: Specific project details (crew names: Mark, Fred, Parker, Heidi; timelines: 5 weeks, 13 weeks)
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (cracked pavers, falling tile, 60-day wait for service)
complaint_patterns: Defective workmanship (cracked pavers, falling tile, deck issues)
Refusal to honor warranty claims after one year
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating discrepancy between Google (4.8) and Yelp (3.1). This is a common pattern where Google reviews are more positive, but the Yelp reviews and negative Google reviews reveal consistent, specific complaints about post-construction service and warranty issues.
